about: Review tests that need the official edition. scripts/review/run-all.mjs reads this file: a listed test runs only when
every entry in its 'needs' exists, otherwise it is reported as SKIP with the missing entry. The public repository does
not ship these test files; run-all.mjs reports them as 'not in this checkout'. Tests that are shared but have an
official-only part are NOT listed here: they print a line starting with 'SKIP' for that part (run-all.mjs lists those
lines in its summary). Mutation runners take their official mutants from scripts/review/mutants_official.py
(mutant_kit.py skips them when that file or the code they change is absent).
A need is a path relative to the repository root, '~/...' for the home folder, or '$VAR' for the path in that
environment variable; 'a | b' means any one of them.

ext_official_antifraud_self_test.mjs.why: scan points of the official anti-fraud extension

risk_score_signing_self_test.mjs.why: signed risk-score requests of the official anti-fraud extension

sealed_blob_unlock_self_test.py.why: AegisID unlock against the real AegisID routes (an AegisID checkout >= a3d85ed; with an older one the test passes part 1 and prints SKIP for part 2)

edition_schema_official_self_test.mjs.why: the official tables in the shared DB (the shared registry is edition_schema_self_test.mjs)

guardian_logout_official_self_test.mjs.why: the official native guardian-data cleanup on logout (the shared part is guardian_logout_self_test.mjs)

key_quarantine_official_self_test.mjs.why: the official AuthScreen's handling of quarantined keys (the shared part is key_quarantine_self_test.mjs)

shared_safety_official_self_test.mjs.why: official PIN change and cloud backup flush (the shared part is shared_safety_self_test.mjs)

w5_review_fixes_official_self_test.mjs.why: guardian check-in config (the shared part is w5_review_fixes_self_test.mjs)

guardian_credentials_self_test.py.why: the official server dropped the guardian credentials

main_wiring_self_test.py.why: how the official server (api/main.py) mounts the chat routers
